UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Cloud-synced JARVIS/Pari user profile and persona preferences.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID matching document ID.

userName.description: Display name used by JARVIS/Pari to address the user (1..80 chars).

personality.description: Active assistant persona (e.g. Pari, Jarvis, Kabir).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of profile creation (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

CloudMemoryItem.title: CloudMemoryItem
CloudMemoryItem.description: Cloud-backed long-term memory item for JARVIS/Pari.

userId.description: Owner Firebase UID matching parent userId path variable.

category.description: Memory category (e.g. preference, fact, relationship, reminder).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when memory was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when memory was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ReleaseManifest.title: ReleaseManifest
ReleaseManifest.description: Signed APK release manifest with SHA-256 verification and minimum version constraints.

minSupportedVersionCode.description: Minimum supported versionCode before force update is triggered.

forceUpdate.description: Whether this release requires immediate installation.

apkUrl.description: HTTPS download URL for the signed APK.

sha256.description: 64-character hex SHA-256 digest of the signed APK.

signingCertSha256.description: Optional 64-character hex SHA-256 digest of the APK signing certificate.

publishedByEmail.description: Email of the authorized owner/admin who published the release.

enabled.description: Whether this release is actively published and downloadable.

isDraft.description: Whether this release manifest is an unpublished draft.

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user cloud profile and persona configuration document.

/app_update/{updateId}.description: Latest published signed APK release manifest (app_update/latest).

/app_update_history/{historyId}.description: Historical APK release manifests for one-tap owner rollback.

/app_update_drafts/{draftId}.description: Draft APK release manifests saved by authorized admins.
